input.question: When was the People's University established?

documents.text: People's University of Amsterdam The People's University of Amsterdam also known as Volks Universiteit Amsterdam or Folk University, is a course centre for adults in Amsterdam. In 1784, the Dutch Maatschappij tot Nut van 't Algemeen was founded and around 1900 there were about 20 so-called Toynbee-associations to English example adult education offered to the lowest social classes. Volksuniversiteit Amsterdam was founded in 1913 and has various course locations in Amsterdam. Since 2016 the Volksuniversiteit Amsterdam works together with the Amsterdam Public Library (Openbare Bibliotheek Amsterdam).
